وُدٌّ : see 1, and وِدٌّ, and وَدٌّ. ―
-b2- بِوُدِّى أَنْ يَكُونَ كَذَا I wish that such a thing may be. In the following saying of the poet, “أَيُّهَا العَائِدُ المُسَائِلُ عَنَّا
وَبِوُدِّيكَ لَوْ ثَرَى أَكْفَانِى
” [O thou visitor of the sick, inquiring respecting us, wishing that thou mayest see my graveclothes], the kesreh of the د is lengthened for sake of the measure. (S, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
